notes.title: Screenshot Sunday!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585639/239a85396b226e98d23a3dae10a6141890be844a.jpg[/img]

We are working to replace all textures and materials in the game with much higher resolutions and also photoscanned materials.

We have added a new lightning system as well as a new volumetric fog system to get that right atmosphere and tension(looks quite good as well)
So the whole game is getting a massive overhaul.

we want the end product to be something like a mix between a next gen amnesia with Silent hills P.T with a bit of lovecraft.
(Picture is work in progress)

Enjoy!
